method_notes: Sweep of Equinix, Digital Realty, AirTrunk, Vantage, STACK, NTT, STT GDC, Keppel, CapitaLand, DayOne/GDS, ESR, PDG, Colt, FPT Telecom/FPT IS, Viettel IDC, VNPT, CMC Telecom, VNG, Digital Edge, EdgeConneX, Empyrion, Microsoft, Google, AWS, Meta, Apple, Bridge, SUPERNAP, Evolution DC, G42, Sembcorp/StarMason, KBC/AIC, BW Industrial.

Places swept: Hanoi (Hoa Lac Hi-Tech, An Khanh), HCMC districts/parks (Tan Thuan EPZ District 7, Saigon Hi-Tech Park / Tang Nhon Phu, Tan Phu Trung IP / Cu Chi, Thu Duc), Bac Ninh, Hai Phong, Da Nang, Quang Ninh, VSIP (hint only).

Allowed SoR only: company IR/press/official DC pages; gov SHTP project card; contractor Vinaconex press for Viettel Tan Phu Trung. Forbidden SoR (Baxtel, DataCenterMap, AIDCI, DC Byte, Wikipedia, consultant averages, news-only recaps) used as hints then verified or rejected.

Grain kept: IT capacity ≠ facility/power (điện) ≠ interconnection ≠ generation/PPA. Sub-250 disclosed pins stay (Evolution VN01 4.75, NTT 6, STT HCMC1 11.2, Viettel Hoa Lac 30, CMC Phase 1 30, Evolution VN02 52, StarMason 60, STT HCMC2 60).
Dry-run only. Do NOT publish to compute.world or GitHub. Fetch cache: /workspace/state/campus-hunt/vietnam-fetch/.
